title: fix(table): defer resize layout beyond native observer delivery
body:
## Summary

- Fix native ResizeObserver undelivered notifications when an ordinary public 50-row, four-column `ElTable` is resized 1440×900↔390×844 three times. Both current and recorded source reproduce three errors; the unchanged original fixture passes with zero errors after the fix.
- Coalesce Table root/body resize measurements, layout scheduling and scrollbar updates in a cancellable animation frame. Native callback microtask checkpoints previously allowed `queueMicrotask(flushLayout)` to write column widths during observer delivery; changed row wrapping then resized the observed root inside that cycle.
- Keep measured container width separate from overflowing content width. Release Table-local observers/listeners on unmount, since their registration follows awaited `nextTick` and cannot rely on the shared hook's scope disposal. No shared hook or other component changes.
- Published source: branch `fix/table-resize-observer-delivery`, commit `07386a74f507d9a6e28559e2f9bea90bab81a00d`, tree `5839c6f4d9fb5966dcbefabad6af62db5559e0eb`. The genuine repository pre-commit hook passed with the executor's existing, repository-pinned pnpm 10.33.0 setup. An ordinary push succeeded and its remote SHA was read back exactly.

## Linked Issue

Refs #883

Tracks the independently reproduced ordinary Vue Table ResizeObserver delivery-loop defect. The issue remains open until its own required validation and postmerge reproduction pass. The separate original QA “853→838” replay was not supplied and remains unverified.

## Impact Checklist

- [x] Component or public API impact is described — ordinary Table resize timing and lifecycle cleanup only; public props, events, slots and exports unchanged. The two production files are `vue/packages/components/table/src/table/style-helper.ts` and `vue/packages/components/table/src/table-layout.ts`.
- [x] Theme token impact is described or not applicable — no token or stylesheet changes. Recorded/current public CSS hashes match.
- [x] Motion token impact is described or not applicable — no motion token changes. Table-owned frame scheduling is corrected; the fixture retains reduced motion.
- [x] Element Plus compatibility impact is described or not applicable — the real public Table fixture and separate fit=false, fixed-column, flexible, auto-layout, height, container-only resize and unmount/remount cases pass locally. No broader compatibility claim or upstream component substitute.
- [x] Visual snapshot impact is described or not applicable — no snapshots or geometry contracts changed. New real-browser assertions verify exact final column/container geometry, native root/body delivery and identical repeated states. The rendered desktop fixture screenshot was inspected.
- [x] Accessibility impact is described or not applicable — no semantic/keyboard/ARIA changes; original row key, label, disabled retry button and 50 rendered rows remain.
- [x] README or docs updated, or docs are not needed — portable fixture README added with exact original replay and source-alias setup; no public contract change requiring component-document edits.

## Release Notes

- [x] Changeset added for user-facing package changes — `.changeset/ordinary-table-resize-delivery.md`, patch release.
- [ ] Changeset not needed because this is internal-only — not applicable; this is a consumer-visible bug fix.
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked in the changeset and migration docs — not applicable; no breaking API change.

## Validation

The full repository gates below are intentionally not represented as passing. Verification was scoped to the owning Table and real original fixture, preserving all existing failures.

- [ ] `pnpm run lint` — full-repository gate not run. Focused ESLint passes on both production files and browser fixture; the genuine pre-commit `pnpm exec lint-staged` hook also passed. Prettier passes for the formatted changed files. `table-layout.ts` retains a pre-existing Prettier failure reproduced on pristine source; its production diff is one removed assignment.
- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck` — web/Vitest lane equivalents were run and failed with exactly the same diagnostics on pristine current source using matched dependency directories: 1,023 web and 1,052 Vitest diagnostics. No new diagnostics. Browser regression/config TypeScript check passes.
- [ ] `pnpm run test` — unrelated full suites not run. Owning Table command below passes 9 files / 129 tests; the new unit regression fails 3 of 4 cases on pristine unfixed source as expected.
- [ ] `pnpm run build` — full build not run; no public package was built or published. The original fixture loads real public source aliases and public CSS.
- [ ] `pnpm run verify:visual:affected` if UI, theme, motion, layout, icons, or demo output changed — broad visual gate not run. All five focused real-browser regressions pass; the original replay passes with zero native window errors. The new browser zero-error assertion fails on recorded unfixed source as expected.
- [ ] `pnpm run test:consumer-install` if public package output, exports, install flow, or registry behavior changed — not applicable to this source-only fix; no package output, export, install flow or registry behavior changes. Private package installation/publication was not exercised.

Focused commands and results, from the UI checkout:

```sh
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vue/vitest.config.ts vue/packages/components/table
# 9 files / 129 tests passed

node vue/tests/table-resize-delivery/original-replay.mjs
# [] raw native errors; exit 0

FSUS_PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config vue/tests/table-resize-delivery/playwright.config.mts
# 5 passed
```

Browser fixture prerequisites and the official `createFsusUiAliases` server setup are documented in `vue/tests/table-resize-delivery/README.md`. Actual browser versions: Vue 3.5.33, Vite 8.0.16, Playwright 1.59.1, Node 24.19.0, Chromium 151.0.7922.173. The original native observer, error listener, zero-error assertion, viewport sequence, three-frame waits, row count and public imports are retained. Additional read-only native observers assert final delivery; no observer replacement or error suppression.

Publication did not change source or relevant dependencies: the committed tree equals the previously verified staged tree exactly, both locks retain their original hashes, and the hook only ran its required ESLint task. The unchanged browser suite was therefore not repeated for publication.

WIP limits: Chromium only; existing broader type/style failures remain; the separate unavailable QA replay remains unverified. Native Avalonia/TableV2 tasks are unrelated. Parent may create this draft immediately without waiting for full issue acceptance. No GitHub content metadata, package publication or merge was performed by this task.

Rollback: revert `07386a74f507d9a6e28559e2f9bea90bab81a00d`. The original fixture and baseline failures remain preserved in the handoff evidence.

Cumulative source handoff: the complete branch contains 15 changed paths, including the two production files and the ordinary regression/fixture/changeset support. Original verification used the recorded b17077f3afd4a80ff3bdc0fe81d5dfc353ffddf2 base. Current main has since received the separately reviewed SDK/lock increment; no results are retrospectively rebound to a new composition. Full inherited/cumulative review remains required.


## Current remote profile status — 2026-10-09 08:23 UTC

The current-head run [37899305543](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/actions/runs/37899305543), attempt 1, is bound to head `07386a74f507d9a6e28559e2f9bea90bab81a00d` and base `8db0ac8f49749e3e5f28be5051bb3d3ed71ada71`. Its jobs have executed despite an earlier incomplete aggregate response.

Current-head failures include [PR real-render performance](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/actions/runs/37899305543/job/113717878953), [PR feedback](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/actions/runs/37899305543/job/113717879059), static quality, Linux/Windows/macOS native qualification, package verification, full real-render performance, visual-runtime reuse, conformance, coverage and Playwright readiness. These are actual failures of this run, not old/base-only evidence. Their existence does not alone establish that this Table source increment introduced each defect.

Bounded Table source/Chromium acceptance remains unchanged. The required complete premerge profile is not green; keep this PR draft and issue #883 open. No failure was waived or replaced with the focused component results.
